title_en: MTG-I2 reaches its final orbit

title_en: SpaceX exceeds 11,000 satellites in low Earth orbit
summary_en: The Starlink 17-50 mission added another 24 broadband satellites to the company’s megaconstellation. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base happened at 9:01 p.m. PDT (12:01 a.m. EDT / 0401 UTC).
